_doc: Landmarks read on the identified captioned plate. Original scan coordinates are reconstructed from the 1000-pixel-wide preview; uncertainty includes halftone screening, hair and occlusion. No invisible eye or concealed mouth outline is treated as precise.
age_note: Undated photograph published 1902. Fit uses estimated age at publication; scene age is driven separately by the person record. For an undated or uncertain birth this is a modelling estimate, not an archival photographic date.
basis: Captioned portrait of this person in Men of Illinois (1902), p. 134, scan leaf 188. Identity cross-checked against household and biographical records. Facial proportions are fitted within the uncertainty of the visible landmarks; single-view depth remains prior-led.
not_modelled: Colour of skin, eyes, hair and clothing: monochrome halftone.
Height and build below the bust.
Exact date of the original photograph and any intervening change in appearance.

card._doc: What the person's card shows (T-3413): `portrait` is cut from the scan at `portrait_from_scan_px` (left, top, right, bottom) and scaled to `size_px`; `model` is tools/portrait_still.mjs's render of the fitted face on `body`, turned to the fit's yaw and framed like the portrait. `dress` (T-3440): the still is dressed as humans.js dresses him in town, with his skin, his own hair and moustache (human-hair-styles.js) and his spectacles (human-spectacles.js). `hide` leaves out his derby: the portrait is bareheaded.
